sloka: रोषेण महता आविष्टो हुम् कारम् अकरोत् तदा ।ततः तेन अप्रमेयेण कपिलेन महात्मना ।भस्म राशी कृताः सर्वे काकुत्स्थ सगरात्मजाः ॥१-४०-३०॥
transliteration: roṣeṇa mahatā āviṣṭo hum kāram akarot tadā ।tataḥ tena aprameyeṇa kapilena mahātmanā ।bhasma rāśī kṛtāḥ sarve kākutstha sagarātmajāḥ ॥1-40-30॥

translations.english: "Then, Kakutstha, by the immeasurable and great-souled Kapila, all the sons of Sagara were reduced to heaps of ash."
